description: Contextual content anchored to a control, with controllable open and close.

howToUse: Use it for a small task attached to a button, that does not need the whole screen: filters, a short form, a color picker.
Control it with `open` and `onOpenChange`, and put the content in `content`. Give it a `label` that names the task.
The rest of the screen stays usable while it is open.
alternatives: A task that blocks everything until it is done: Modal.
Text only, with no controls: Tooltip.

keyboard.action: Opens the popover and moves focus to its first control.
Closes it and returns focus to the button.

props.name: open
props.description: Visible popover (controlled; the overlay has no internal state).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Close request: Esc or click outside.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label of the floating dialog.
